summary: Registered the durable-state consequence of the recovered-configuration defect: added sources src_snapshot_carries_config (snapshot.go:155-190, takeSnapshot records the tracked committed configuration and its index) and src_restore_snapshot_config (api.go:653-684, restoreSnapshot installs that metadata into the tracked configuration), the reusable behavior @k_snapshot_records_committed_config, and a fixed experiment in draft/assurance_multi_test.go. The new TestAssuranceRecoveredSnapshotConfiguration restarts a three-voter node with RestoreCommittedLogs on and no snapshot (local construction run: empty tracked configuration at index 0 while its log holds the index-1 three-voter entry), takes a snapshot through the normal path (snapshot metadata records 0 members at index 0 versus the log's 3-voter entry, so comparison 1 is expected violated), then restarts with the replay disabled (comes up with no configuration and no leader, so comparison 2 is expected violated), asserting that the snapshot must record the configuration the log establishes and that a flag-off restart must not come up without membership. Retained receipt pending; the flag-off observation window is 1500ms.
